dashboard.label: Better Map - Showcase (Demo data)
dashboard.description: One-click showcase of the three bundled demo presets: Oslo last-mile fleet telemetry (tracking + time scrubber + 3D cargo extrusion), Fornebu HQ smart-building IoT sensor mesh (per-floor alarm states + heatmap), and a global cyber-incident SOC view (hexbin aggregation + MITRE chips + RBA risk colouring). Each panel hits the Better Map viz with an empty SPL result and picks a demoPreset in the formatter so the bundled deterministic dataset renders without any live Splunk data. Use this dashboard to evaluate the viz, screenshot for marketing, or demo to a customer on a laptop with no Splunk lab.
